reason: My staff already answer enquiries on WhatsApp and IndiaMART the same day, and my rates change with raw material every week, so I don't see why I should pay Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month for a system to draft what my sales boy types in two minutes.
objection: My price list changes all the time; if your system quotes yesterday's rate even once, I lose margin or I lose the buyer. And one website for one chemical company is not a track record. I would also want two more quotes before I believe Rs 60,000 is the right price.
would_change_my_mind: Show me it working on my own Excel price list for two weeks free, with every quote correct after a rate change, and bring the setup down to around Rs 30,000 with the monthly fee only starting once I see more orders.
